title: Cut kanb.us over to the Kanbus-web site in the kanbus-production account
description:
State 2026-10-19: AnthusAI/Kanbus-web (private) holds the Markus site; main and staging exist. The first CDK deploy into account 494166748521 (kanbus-production) was run manually by Ryan on 2026-10-17, and app-shell changes deploy through a CodePipeline (commit ad8df142) rather than a personal login. The methodologies feature page merged as Kanbus-web PR #1. The old kanb.us site and its DNS are probably in the legacy Anthus account 335163751677.

Remaining: (1) confirm where the kanb.us hosted zone and the current certificate live; (2) cross-account certificate and DNS work so kanb.us and www point at the kanbus-production distribution; (3) Papyrus CMS at newsroom.kanb.us for browser editing; (4) remove the retired apps/kanb.us site from this monorepo once cutover is verified; (5) screenshots of the live site against the plan in the project files (website/kanbus-web-plan.md).

Constraints: AWS work runs only on Ryan's M1 via Remote Control after Ryan signs in (admin profile Endymion); cloud threads get no AWS credentials. Routine updates must go through CI/CD using GitHub OIDC federation, not manual CLI deploys. Kanbus-web is private, so its CI/CD runs in AWS CodePipeline.

Acceptance: kanb.us serves the Kanbus-web site from kanbus-production over TLS, a push to Kanbus-web main deploys without a personal login, and the old DNS records are retired.
